brand.portal_lede:
When you listen to music, you're hearing your power supply.

Tubes as a category sound better because they force low-noise power supplies.

Digital systems are just as sensitive, they just fail more gracefully.

We plant our flag here because it's strategically advantageous; it's also the truth.
brand.portal_section_lede: Each door opens on a short introduction, then a deep dive built from the full brand development document. Working notes stay visible until a section is signed off.

portal_notes.title: How to read this
portal_notes.body: The intro pages are the pitch: one headline, three points, the measurements that matter. The deep dives carry everything the brand document held, reorganised by topic. Nothing has been invented; where a line was drafted for this site rather than lifted from the document, it carries an **assumed** badge.

portal_notes.title: Standing lines
portal_notes.body: **All Grounds Floating** under the mark. **Even Rails → Smooth Tracks** in the nav. **Measured in silence.** on the certificate. **Pure signal.** for campaigns. Everything else is open for discussion.

options.title: All Grounds Floating
options.summary: The name, the thesis behind it, the six tenets, and the posture: lead, or by definition follow.

options.title: History rhymes
options.summary: Two eras of consolidation, one safe harbor that nobody has occupied since Bang & Olufsen walked away from it.

options.title: Six technologies, one signal path
options.summary: l'Art, stereOS, BT'N-Tech, l'espacI/O, FRC41 and No-Nails: the moat, from capture to the room.

options.title: The inaugural product line
options.summary: Six products from a shared platform, sequenced for time-to-market, landing the flagship just above Focal.

options.title: A church of the performing arts
options.summary: Front of House, the Balcony, the Green Room: retail hidden behind a stage, one venue per qualifying market.

options.title: Artists drive their own destiny
options.summary: Artists own the stereo master outright. Broadcast mixes are 50/50 in perpetuity. The artist can block any broadcast.

options.title: The way the money actually works
options.summary: Pricing the package, not the unit. Distribution as the future bank-roller. Where AGF lands against the field.

options.title: Sequencing the line
options.summary: Three phases over 24 months, two PR levers, five venue pilots and a 1,000-piece-a-month year-one target.

options.title: Twenty-five years in this market
options.summary: Benjamin Webster: from garage-sale speakers to Mass Fidelity, a Dolby skunkworks, and the plan on the page.
